svg.title: Two alternative graph paths with unequal observed read support
svg.desc: A schematic edge-labelled de Bruijn graph at k equals 3. From AT, the upper path passes through TG and GA to AA, spelling ATGAA. Twelve read records span this path. The lower path passes through TC and CA to AA, spelling ATCAA. Three read records span it. The counts are invented observations; whether they represent independent input molecules is not established. Neither path is deleted.
svg.metadata: Adapted from bioinformatis-web/book/figures/ch03/f3-topology-cleanup.svg, Apache-2.0. Modification: replaced automatic bubble removal and coverage-proves-truth claims with verified alternative paths, invented branch-spanning read-record counts, and an explicit unresolved evidence decision. See ../../third_party/bioinformatis-web-LICENSE.

g.text: Toy counts of records spanning a whole path; molecular independence is unknown.
k = 3 · two-base nodes · three-base edge labels · neither path has been removed
